name: Podman Remote Client
description: Installs the Podman CLI and sets CONTAINER_HOST to unix:///tmp/podman.sock so podman commands talk to the host's Podman socket (Docker-outside-of-Docker). The host socket is a host bind mount that this feature does not declare (the path is machine-specific); the consuming devcontainer.json must bind the hostSocketPath (default /var/run/user/1000/podman/podman.sock) to /tmp/podman.sock.

hostSocketPath.description: Path of the host Podman socket. Bind this path into the container (to /tmp/podman.sock, which CONTAINER_HOST points at) via a mounts entry in devcontainer.json.
